quarterly_data.quarter: Jenoptik press release: Significant increase in orders and earnings in first half (08-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 release additions to the call: revenue EUR 503.2 million (+1.0%); Semiconductor & Advanced Manufacturing revenue EUR 230.4 million (+10.2%), Biophotonics EUR 113.9 million (-4.5%), Metrology & Production Solutions EUR 79.7 million (prior year EUR 92.0 million) and Smart Mobility Solutions EUR 68.3 million (+10.7%); order intake EUR 723.4 million (+53.0%), with Semiconductor & Advanced Manufacturing orders up 85.3%; order backlog EUR 824.8 million; capex EUR 19.7 million (prior year EUR 32.6 million); free cash flow before interest and taxes EUR 47.2 million; net debt EUR 307.5 million and leverage 1.4x. FY2026 capex is expected slightly below the prior year's EUR 77.4 million, with optics capacity at the Jena site in particular to be expanded.
